description: Get booking information for a course already returned by search_courses or find_nearby_courses. Returns its Stymie course-page link, where the golfer can find the official website or phone, plus an optional early-access alerts page. This legacy search_tee_times tool does not search live inventory: status is always not_available. It cannot book, pay, enroll in alerts, or confirm availability.

slug.description: Canonical Stymie course URL or full_slug returned by a course lookup

name: search_tee_times
title: Get course booking information
